comment: Written against goose CLI 1.53.0 (Homebrew block-goose-cli; line UI on the normal screen) from live sessions recorded in a pty against an OpenAI-compatible LM Studio endpoint with GOOSE_MODE=approve; must be re-verified when goose changes its UI. goose writes into the scrollback, and an answered tool question stays visible with a hollow '◇' marker and the chosen option, so every rule looks only at the last lines. The open tool question ('◆  Goose would like to call the above tool, do you allow?' with '│  ● Allow' / '│  ○ Deny' options, filled '◆') is BLOCKED; the spinner line ending in '(Ctrl+C to interrupt)' is WORKING; the '>' input line as the last line ('> Enter to send · Ctrl+J newline' when empty) is IDLE. Between the spinner and the next prompt goose prints tool output and streams its answer, so the fallback is WORKING. pressly's database-migration tool is also named goose; it never shows these screens, so it is never reported. No rule depends on the alternate-screen flag.

anyLineRegex: ^◆\s+Goose would like to call the above tool
